This is the pattern `docs/reference/figures.qmd` documents in prose: the table alone inside a cross-referenced div, with Quarto owning the float, the number and the caption.

The import resolves because `tools/quarto-check.sh` renders a staged copy of this file beside a link to the package, which makes `/lib.typ` the working tree.

```{=typst}
#import "/lib.typ": *
#show figure: set block(breakable: true)
```

@tbl-sales reports the figures.

::: {#tbl-sales}

```{=typst}
#display-table(
  (
    product: ("Bolt", "Nut", "Beam"),
    units: (1250, 860, 430),
    margin: (0.182, 0.031, 0.094),
  ),
  table-stub(rowname: "product", label: [Product]),
  columns-label(units: [Units], margin: [Margin]),
  format-integer("units"),
  format-percent("margin", decimals: 1),
  table-source-note([Source: internal ledger.]),
)
```

Regional sales for the year.

:::
